checks.name: Live registry and signed current graph
checks.detail: Official public Tiramisu RPC, explicit same snapshot, authenticated registry, every manifest-listed graph member.

checks.name: Both actual published graph revisions readable
checks.detail: Each distinct root is independently reconstructed from signed Arkiv entities at the registry snapshot.

checks.name: Serialized checkpoint accepts the same signed head
checks.detail: A returning client reloads the serialized monotonic root checkpoint.

checks.name: Hidden latest revision rejected after checkpoint
checks.detail: Provider omission simulated by removing the actual sequence-two head from a previously observed chain.

checks.name: Tampered live root payload rejected
checks.detail: One byte-bound field is changed while retaining the original real signature.

checks.name: Chain, registry, policy and profile substitutions rejected
checks.detail: Existing actual revision signatures cannot cross the pinned scope.

checks.name: Expired head refuses new use
checks.detail: Verification clock deliberately moved beyond the signed head deadline; historical links are not rewritten.

checks.name: Unauthorized signed root rejected
checks.detail: A fresh in-memory test signer cannot replace the pinned authority. No key is stored or published.

checks.name: Different correctly signed branch rejected at checkpoint
checks.detail: A separate ephemeral authority signs two valid branches solely to test fork detection; no network write occurs.

checks.name: Single live provider remains explicitly labeled
checks.detail: The real official endpoint counts as one operator. This is not quorum or non-omission proof.

checks.name: Older RPC snapshot rejected after local checkpoint
checks.detail: The real observation is locally altered to an older block; the retained checkpoint refuses it.

checks.name: Stale chain time rejected
checks.detail: The real observation is locally altered to a five-minute-old chain time.

checks.name: Configured operators disagree: fail closed
checks.detail: Two simulated operator observations differ in state at one block. No second live provider is claimed.

checks.name: Endpoint aliases cannot create independent operator quorum
checks.detail: Two locally configured endpoint IDs sharing one operator are rejected under minimum-two policy.

checks.name: Published signed withdrawal retained before task
checks.detail: Actual public session envelopes and source evidence are replayed locally; this does not broadcast or assert a new chain read.

checks.name: Reloaded consumer refuses omission of observed withdrawal
checks.detail: A new consumer loads the same serialized checkpoint while a simulated later response omits the actual withdrawal.

checks.name: Withdrawal seen without target survives later target restoration
checks.detail: Actual signed withdrawal is first returned without its review; a later controlled response restores that review and omits the withdrawal.

checks.name: Tampered cached signature refuses without overwriting state
checks.detail: Cached real withdrawal signature is damaged locally; task remains blocked and failed verification preserves existing stored state.

checks.name: Persistence failure prevents task admission
checks.detail: A local store write is deliberately refused before the deterministic task can execute.

withdrawal.scope: The journal tests replay actual public signed session envelopes with controlled local response omission. They do not claim a new withdrawal publication or an external independent consumer.

limitations: The official public Tiramisu endpoint remains one provider. No independent live-provider quorum or cryptographic query-completeness proof is implemented.
Authenticated revision chains and local checkpoints prevent tampering and observed rollback/forks. They cannot discover an unseen newer head omitted by every source.
Local browser storage is client-controlled. Deleting/resetting it loses observed history; local compromise is not prevented.
Provider timestamps, chain metadata and indexed query completeness remain provider assumptions; the local freshness check uses the client clock.
Synthetic fault injection and public-signed-evidence replay are labeled separately from actual current RPC reads.
reproduce: npm run build:sdk && npx tsx scripts/verify-trust-safeguards.ts
source_status: SDK/source functionality in this checkout; npm release version must be checked independently.
